careers.title: Chief Executives
careers.summary: Determine and formulate policies and provide overall direction of companies or private and public sector organizations within guidelines set up by a board of directors or similar governing body.
tasks: Direct or coordinate an organization's financial or budget activities to fund operations, maximize investments, or increase efficiency.
Confer with board members, organization officials, or staff members to discuss issues, coordinate activities, or resolve problems.
Prepare budgets for approval, including those for funding or implementation of programs.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs 5 years or more of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

careers.title: Chief Sustainability Officers
careers.summary: Communicate and coordinate with management, shareholders, customers, and employees to address sustainability issues. Enact or oversee a corporate sustainability strategy.
tasks: Monitor and evaluate effectiveness of sustainability programs.
Develop or execute strategies to address issues such as energy use, resource conservation, recycling, pollution reduction, waste elimination, transportation, education, and building design.
Develop, or oversee the development of, sustainability evaluation or monitoring systems.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs 5 years or more of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

careers.title: Advertising and Promotions Managers
careers.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate advertising policies and programs or produce collateral materials, such as posters, contests, coupons, or giveaways, to create extra interest in the purchase of a product or service for a department, an entire organization, or on an account basis.
tasks: Plan and prepare advertising and promotional material to increase sales of products or services, working with customers, company officials, sales departments, and advertising agencies.
Inspect layouts and advertising copy, and edit scripts, audio, video, and other promotional material for adherence to specifications.
Direct, motivate, and monitor the mobilization of a campaign team to advance campaign goals.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs less than 5 years of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

careers.title: Sales Managers
careers.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate the actual distribution or movement of a product or service to the customer. Coordinate sales distribution by establishing sales territories, quotas, and goals and establish training programs for sales representatives.
tasks: Oversee regional and local sales managers and their staffs.
Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service.
Monitor customer preferences to determine focus of sales efforts.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs less than 5 years of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

careers.title: Public Relations Managers
careers.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities designed to create or maintain a favorable public image or raise issue awareness for their organization or client.
tasks: Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, government officials, and media representatives and use these relationships to develop new business opportunities.
Assign, supervise, and review the activities of public relations staff.
Identify main client groups and audiences, determine the best way to communicate publicity information to them, and develop and implement a communication plan.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs 5 years or more of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

careers.title: Fundraising Managers
careers.summary: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities to solicit and maintain funds for special projects or nonprofit organizations.
tasks: Develop strategies to encourage new or increased contributions.
Plan and direct special events for fundraising, such as silent auctions, dances, golf events, or walks.
Compile or develop materials to submit to granting or other funding organizations.
start: Typical entry requirement: bachelor's degree
Usually needs 5 years or more of experience in a related occupation
Read the full profile on My Next Move for skills, related titles and local job listings

tasks: Analyze internal processes and recommend and implement procedural or policy changes to improve operations, such as supply changes or the disposal of records.
Conduct classes to teach procedures to staff.
